comments.body: I would like to discuss (before we do EL/CL breakout) new insights regarding the repricing numbers and a proposal for glamsterdam-devnet-8.

Do clients have a MB release limit for creating binary releases for devnet-8? We are considering how many exited validators we can add and wanted to know if 70 MB genesis.ssz is too large for a baked in release?
What is the most you'd be comfortable with?
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
